integrity: Complete analytic proof and a standalone finite diagnostic are included; finite diagnostics do not replace proof. All public claims concern the same fixed-gap singular-spectrum result.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer gap d≥1 and radial beta parameter 0<β<1; all individual commutators have finite rank. The threshold governs asymptotic Schatten-mass scaling, not ideal membership. No variable-gap or general-symbol extension is claimed. Publication priority remains subject to independent bibliographic verification.
title: A fixed-gap bulk–interface Schatten transition for weighted harmonic Bergman Toeplitz commutators
